description.text: The second Gym expansion pack, released in Japan on 25 June 1999. It centers on the Pokémon of Sabrina and Blaine, and of Koga and Giovanni, the two Gym Leaders who never had a starter deck of their own, with a few more cards for Brock, Misty, Lt. Surge, Erika and Team Rocket. In English its cards went into Gym Challenge, released in October 2000.
